newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline supported as more cargoes sail west.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline supported as more cargoes sail west.

text.p: NWE gasoline was steady to soft as NYMEX gasoline fell on Wednesday, but fresh arbitrage deals to the U.S. supported prices, traders said.
Eurograde barges traded at $204.50, $205.50 and $206 fob ARA. $202 was also rumoured done, but this was not confirmed.

A 30,000-tonne Eurograde cargo was sold transatlantic at November NYMEX -$4.75, fob NWE. Another Eurograde cargo was heard sold at November -$5.25. A mixed M4/V4 cargo was also heard moved, and a fourth U.K.-origin cargo was also rumoured sold transatlantic. A Superplus cargo was also heard bought into Lavera. -- Nicholas Shaxson, London newsroom +44 171 542 8167
